correctness_source_support.text: In the working tree, a nonfinal send rejection with AbortError enters an uninterruptible 80 ms sleep before the next pre-attempt signal check. Close and deadline clear are delayed; this is not necessarily an extra send if signal remains aborted. Pre-aborted signal is checked only after transport.open.

Per-attempt deadline timers are eventually cleared in finally, not permanently leaked on ordinary rejection. Promise.race does not cancel an unresolved send; timeout retry may overlap it. Signal is only passed through to send; an ignoring transport can still resolve successfully after abort.

Names actual snapshot identity and differentiates HEAD attempts=2 from staged/worktree attempts=3, unstaged doubled delay, and untracked ticket. Does not attribute every file to HEAD. Uses captured real Git status/hash rather than fictional commit IDs.

Existing tests cover immediate success/cleanup and final failure, not in-flight abort, abort during backoff, ignored signal, unresolved timed-out send or failed close. The report proposes targeted verification and distinguishes proposals from observed runtime evidence.

structure_operation.text: The report includes reproducible code/state locators and concrete proposed tests.
Any CLI/schema result described in the report is distinguished from runtime behavior evidence; a schema pass is not presented as proof of cancellation correctness.

clarity_visual.text: Separates paths/conditions so a maintainer can follow cancellation timing and pending work; no mandated diagram or section recipe.

human_comprehension.text: Use withheld new-code scenarios with consenting developers; do not infer learning from report correctness.

transfer.question: 另一个重试器只在每轮开始检查取消信号，catch 后等待固定 200 ms。请求在等待前取消并报错。下一次调用一定会发生吗？资源何时有机会释放？
transfer.expected_reasoning: No next call if next loop check sees abort; cancellation/cleanup can still be delayed until the non-abortable wait finishes. Distinguish responsiveness from extra calls.

transfer.question: Promise.race 的超时分支先完成，底层上传 Promise 没有结束。可以认为上传已停止并安全重试吗？为什么？
transfer.expected_reasoning: No; race settles its wrapper but does not stop the losing operation. Need explicit cancellation/settlement or idempotency/concurrency handling.

transfer.question: 报告标注了提交号，但实际阅读的文件有未提交修改。别人只检出提交号能复现结论吗？还需要保留什么？
transfer.expected_reasoning: Not necessarily; retain HEAD identity, index and working-tree content hashes/diffs plus untracked contents and relevant environment.
